policy: Do not add a new src/<name>_generated sibling. New compilers write under an existing frozen root, or under src/generated/resources after an ownership lock that separates Java HashCache from Python artifacts. A relative path may exist in only one resource root; processResources depends on checkResourceDuplicates.
